B2R2 is the next-generation binary analysis framework that runs purely
on .NET. This is the B2R2 launcher, which is a .NET CLI tool that can
invoke various tools provided by our framework. To know more about
B2R2, please visit our official website: https://b2r2.org/.

Usage: b2r2 [app name]

[Available Apps]

- scan (a.k.a. binscan)

  This is a file format scanner that is similar to readelf or otool.
  You can read various file format information using this app. To
  learn more about the tool, type the following command:

  $ b2r2 scan --help

- disasm (a.k.a. bindisasm)

  This is a linear-sweep disassembler similar to objdump, although
  this app is more powerful and versatile. To learn more about the
  tool, type the following command:

  $ b2r2 disasm --help

- explore (a.k.a. binexplore)

  This is a recursive-descent disassembler that provides a web-based
  GUI as well as its own CLI terminal. To learn more about the tool,
  type the following command:

  $ b2r2 explore --help

- repl

  This is a REPL (Read Evaluate Print Loop) for our binary IR as well
  as binary assembly languages. To learn more about the tool type the
  following command:

  $ b2r2 repl --help

- asm (a.k.a. assembler)

  This is a simple cross-platform assembler. To learn more about the
  tool, type the following command:

  $ b2r2 asm --help

[Usage]

b2r2 scan [opts...] <binary file(s)>

[General Options]

-h, --help                       : Show this usage
-v, --verbose                    : Verbose mode
-b, --base-addr <address>        : Specify the base <address> in hex (default=0)
-a, --all                        : Display all the file information
-H, --file-header                : Display the file header
-S, --section-headers            : Display the section headers
-d, --section-details <name>     : Display the <name> section details
-s, --symbols                    : Display the symbols
-r, --relocations                : Display the relocation section
-f, --functions                  : Display the function symbols
-x, --exceptions                 : Display the exception table

[ELF options]

--program-headers                : Display the program headers
--plt                            : Display the PLT-GOT information
--ehframe                        : Display the eh_frame information
--gcc-except-table               : Display the gcc_except_table information
--notes                          : Display the notes information
--debug                          : Display the debug information

[PE options]

--imports                        : Display the import table
--exports                        : Display the export table
--optional-header                : Display the optional header
--clr-header                     : Display the CLR header
--dependencies                   : Display the dependencies

[Mach-O options]

--archive-header                 : Display the archive header
--universal-header               : Display the universal header
--load-commands                  : Display the load commands
--shared-libs                    : Display the shared libraries
-i, --isa <ISA>                  : Specify <ISA> (e.g., x86) for fat binaries

[Usage]

b2r2 disasm [opts...] <binary file(s) | -s hexstring>

[General Options]

-h, --help                    : Show this usage
-v, --verbose                 : Verbose mode
-i, --isa <ISA>               : Specify <ISA> (e.g., x86)
-r, --base-addr <address>     : Specify the base <address> in hex (default=0)

[Input Configuration]

-s <hexstring>                : Specify an input <hexstring>
-m, --mode <OPT>              : Specify <operation mode> (e.g., thumb/arm)
--raw-binary                  : Turn off file format detection

[Output Configuration]

--att                         : Use AT&T syntax for disassembling Intel instructions
-S, --section <OPT>           : Display the contents of a specific section
--only-disasm                 : Always display disassembly for all sections.
--show-addr                   : Show addresses of hexstring
--hide-symbols                : Show symbols while disassembling binary
--show-wide                   : Show hexdump with 32 bytes per line
--show-color                  : Show colored hexdump
--lift                        : Show LowUIR of excutable sections

[Optional Configuration]

--optimize                    : Perform bblock optimization for IL
